answer: The 5 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. Because the saffron beacon is unpredictable until close, the orchard panel cannot be arranged, and the pearl audit records the draw inputs for every case. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
